name: qwen-image-2.0-pro
description: The full-scale model in the Qwen-Image-2.0 series unifies image generation and editing. It features professional-grade text rendering, supports instructions of up to 1K tokens, produces finely detailed photorealistic visuals, and follows complex prompts more accurately. As the series’ most capable variant, it delivers its strongest text rendering and visual realism.
zhDescription: Qwen-Image-2.0系列满血版模型，实现了图片生成和图片编辑的融合；具备更专业的文字渲染1k token指令支持能力、更细腻的真实质感，细腻刻画写实场景、更强的语义遵循能力。满血版具备2.0系列最强的文字渲染能力和真实质感。
